sessionStart.command: continuitydb hook session-start --client cursor --project inventory-service --home /absolute/private/path/continuitydb-data --tenant-id example-org --owner-id example-user --agent-id cursor --allowed-sensitivities 'public,private'

stop.command: continuitydb hook checkpoint --client cursor --project inventory-service --home /absolute/private/path/continuitydb-data --tenant-id example-org --owner-id example-user --agent-id cursor --allowed-sensitivities 'public,private' --file /workspace/inventory-service/.continuitydb-handoff.json
